claim_boundary: Outcome signals are truth-safe opt-in ranking hints only; this benchmark does not prove broad answer quality, token/cost saving, or default signal influence.

tasks.prompt: Record a used context outcome for a surfaced source id and verify the opt-in search response exposes a positive bounded context_outcome_score with ranking_explanation metadata.
Record an ignored context outcome for a surfaced source id and verify the signal is counted without mutating confirmed truth.
Record a misleading context outcome for a surfaced source id and verify the opt-in ranking hint is negative, bounded, and explained.
Search with weak_link_signals disabled and verify stored outcome signals do not affect ranking or imply default-on influence.
Compare confirmed truth counts before and after outcome recording to verify the loop writes retrieval signals only.
